# Platform logos: sources and licences

These logos appear in the platform table at the top of the README, at 22 px, only to show on which platforms Immuch360 runs. Each one is a trademark of its owner (see the "License and trademark" section of the README). Showing them here implies no endorsement by, or affiliation with, any of these companies or projects.

All files were downloaded on 9 October 2026. Every file is a plain SVG with a square viewBox, no script, no text and no external reference.

| File | Platform | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `android.svg` | Android phones and tablets | Google, Android brand guidelines | CC BY 3.0 (attribution below) |
| `apple.svg` | iPhone, iPad and macOS | Wikimedia Commons | Public domain (PD-textlogo), trademark |
| `meta.svg` | Meta Quest | Wikimedia Commons | Public domain (PD-textlogo), trademark |
| `googletv.svg` | Android TV and Google TV | Wikimedia Commons | Public domain (PD-textlogo), trademark |
| `windows.svg` | Windows | Wikimedia Commons | Public domain (PD-textlogo), trademark |
| `linux.svg` | Linux | Wikimedia Commons | Attribution (Larry Ewing and The GIMP; Simon Budig notice below; Garrett LeSage CC0) |

## android.svg

- Platform: Android phones and tablets.
- Mark: the Android robot head, flat version, as published by Google.
- Source: Google, Android brand guidelines, https://developer.android.com/distribute/marketing-tools/brand-guidelines (section "Android robot"), file https://developer.android.com/static/images/brand/android-head_flat.svg
- Same drawing on Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Android_Robot_Head_2023.svg (tagged PD-textlogo and trademarked there).
- Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), as stated by Google on the brand guidelines page: "The green Android robot can be reproduced and/or modified as long as the following Creative Commons attribution line is included in the creative". Google retains all trademark rights to the Android robot.
- Attribution (required): The Android robot is reproduced or modified from work created and shared by Google and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 3.0 Attribution License.
- Changes: removed the clip path (a rectangle the size of the drawing) and the `fill="none"` root attribute; set a square viewBox (151 x 151) with the head centred vertically; added an intrinsic size of 64 x 64. Shape and colours unchanged (head `#34A853`, eyes `#202124`).

## apple.svg

- Platform: iPhone and iPad, and macOS.
- Mark: the Apple logo.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Apple_logo_grey.svg (file https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1b/Apple_logo_grey.svg). Original design by Rob Janoff for Apple Inc.
- Licence: public domain on Wikimedia Commons under {{PD-textlogo}} (simple geometric shape, below the threshold of originality, {{TOO-US}}), marked {{Trademark}}. Apple is a trademark of Apple Inc.
- Attribution: not required by the licence.
- Changes: fill changed from `#b3b3b3` to `#8e8e93` so that it reads on both the light and the dark GitHub themes; square viewBox with a small margin (about 4 %) for an even visual weight next to the other logos; XML declaration removed; intrinsic size of 64 x 64. Shape unchanged.

## meta.svg

- Platform: Meta Quest headsets.
- Mark: the Meta symbol (without the "Meta" wordmark).
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Meta_Platforms_Inc._logo_(cropped).svg (file https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/05/Meta_Platforms_Inc._logo_%28cropped%29.svg), from Meta's own brand file on about.facebook.com.
- Licence: public domain on Wikimedia Commons under {{PD-textlogo}} and {{TOO-US}}, marked {{Trademarked}}. Meta and Meta Quest are trademarks of Meta Platforms, Inc.
- Attribution: not required by the licence.
- Changes: removed the `<desc>` element and the unused namespace declarations; gradient stop colours written as attributes instead of `style`; square viewBox with the symbol centred vertically; intrinsic size of 64 x 64. Paths, gradients and colours (Meta blue, `#0064e1` to `#0082fb`) unchanged.

## googletv.svg

- Platform: Android TV and Google TV.
- Mark: the Google TV icon.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Google_TV_Icon.svg (file https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e3/Google_TV_Icon.svg), author Google, from https://blog.google/products/google-tv/
- Licence: public domain on Wikimedia Commons under {{PD-textlogo}}, marked {{Trademarked}}. Google TV and Android TV are trademarks of Google LLC.
- Attribution: not required by the licence.
- Changes: square viewBox with the icon centred vertically; `version` attribute and line breaks removed; intrinsic size of 64 x 64. Shape and colours unchanged.
- Why this mark: the Android TV logo on Commons is a wordmark only (text), while the Google TV icon is a mark without text and Google TV is the current name of the platform on recent TVs.

## windows.svg

- Platform: Windows.
- Mark: the Windows logo (four squares, Windows 11 version).
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Windows_logo_-_2021.svg (file https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/87/Windows_logo_-_2021.svg).
- Licence: public domain on Wikimedia Commons under {{PD-textlogo}}, marked {{Trademarked}}. Windows is a trademark of the Microsoft group of companies.
- Attribution: not required by the licence.
- Changes: viewBox widened by about 11 % on each side so that the full square does not look heavier than the other logos at 22 px; intrinsic size of 64 x 64. Shape and colour (`#0078d4`) unchanged.

## linux.svg

- Platform: Linux.
- Mark: Tux, the Linux penguin.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tux.svg (file https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/35/Tux.svg). Authors: Larry Ewing (original drawing, made with The GIMP, https://isc.tamu.edu/~lewing/linux/), Simon Budig (vector version, http://www.home.unix-ag.org/simon/penguin/), Garrett LeSage (current SVG, https://github.com/garrett/Tux).
- Licence: attribution only.
  - Larry Ewing (https://isc.tamu.edu/~lewing/linux/, archived copy of January 2025): "Permission to use and/or modify this image is granted provided you acknowledge me lewing@isc.tamu.edu and The GIMP if someone asks."
  - Simon Budig, copyright notice that has to go with any redistribution: "Originally drewn by Larry Ewing (http://www.isc.tamu.edu/~lewing/) (with the GIMP) the Linux Logo has been vectorized by me (Simon Budig, http://www.home.unix-ag.org/simon/). [...] These drawings are copyrighted by Larry Ewing and Simon Budig (penguin-variant.sk also by Anja Gerwinski), redistribution is free but has to include this README/Copyright notice." Full text: http://www.home.unix-ag.org/simon/penguin/README
  - Garrett LeSage: CC0 for his changes.
  - Linux is the registered trademark of Linus Torvalds in the U.S. and other countries.
- Attribution (required): Tux, the Linux penguin, by Larry Ewing (lewing@isc.tamu.edu), drawn with The GIMP; vector version by Simon Budig and Garrett LeSage.
- Changes: removed the `<title>` element and the small glare and cast shadow layers that cannot be seen at 22 px (body glare, wing glares, foot glares, pupil glares, beak glares, right foot shadow, right wing tip shadow and glare); kept the body, belly shading, eyes, beak with its shadows, and feet; then minified (coordinates rounded to one decimal, unused definitions removed, identifiers shortened); viewBox widened from 216 x 256 to a square 256 x 256 with the penguin centred; intrinsic size of 64 x 64. Colours unchanged. Size reduced from 49,983 to 19,365 bytes.
